document.abstract: The spray application of developing solutions sensitive to oxidation requires that an inert spray atmosphere be used. Methods are described to accomplish this relatively simply and inexpensively. Experimental studies have been made of spray nozzle arrays for a variety of processing conditions. The factors that may affect the design of spray processing machines are discussed.
